title: Star Wars: The Force Unleashed CIB (Nintendo Wii, 2008)
descriptionText:
Immerse yourself in the Star Wars universe with Star Wars: The Force Unleashed for the Nintendo Wii. This action-packed game, released in 2008, allows you to play as the deadly duo of Jedi Knights, Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano, as they journey through the galaxy to uncover the truth about Order 76. With a T-Teen rating, this game is suitable for players of all ages.

Published by LucasArts, this game falls under the Action & Adventure genre and features stunning graphics that will transport you to a galaxy far, far away. Star Wars: The Force Unleashed is a must-have for any Star Wars fan and is sure to provide hours of entertainment. Get your hands on this complete in box (CIB) game today!
